header.title: How to Convert a Built-in Dishwasher to a Freestanding One
header.description: This guide details the process of transforming a built-in dishwasher into a freestanding unit. It covers hose conversion, platform construction, and optional cabinet additions to create a mobile dishwasher.

steps.description: This step involves removing the dishwasher from its storage space and disconnecting it from the power source.
actions: Remove plug from socket (if plug-in unit)
Shut off power from breaker panel (if hard-wired)
Disconnect all wires from power source

steps.description: This step involves attaching two hoses (water supply and discharge) to the dishwasher, potentially extending them and ensuring they are the proper grade.
actions: Attach a water supply hose to the dishwasher.
Attach a discharge hose to the dishwasher.
Hook the discharge line onto a sink or draining system.
Check with the appliance store for specific adapters and tools.

steps.description: Construct a mobile platform for the dishwasher, ensuring secure mounting and stability.
actions: Build a platform out of lumber
Measure the dimensions of the dishwasher
Attach the dishwasher with mounting screws
Install a 1-by-6 foot board for tipping prevention
Build a post for the dishwasher door to rest on

steps.description: This step involves constructing a cabinet, either wooden or metal, around the converted unit to create a kitchen island.
actions: Consider using wood as a material
Consider using metal panels for a modern look
